additional_inspected_untagged_sources.summary: For the online in-game scene and a zero-valued field read through 0x80479d64, disables interrupts and checks the ODB. If the parent reports input work, it proceeds to prepare engine loops; with no parent input but rollback active it sets r27 to one so a rollback iteration can run. It copies rollback-active, rollback-end, should-load-state, and savestate-frame values into stable ODB fields before the engine-loop code. With no input and no rollback, it may clear the force-pad-renew flag and call RenewInputs_Prefunction. It then follows the replaced parent branch/wait flow.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.gameplay_relevance: Controls whether and how the online game engine advances during rollback; direct simulation-step timing/control.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.unresolved_dependency: The source calls 0x80479d64 “Believed to be some loading state”; parent routine register and branch meanings, interrupt safety, RenewInputs_Prefunction behavior, relationship to input hook mutation, and executable-address correspondence are not validated.

additional_inspected_untagged_sources.gameplay_relevance: Changes controller-input renewal/engine-loop work after an advance response, affecting which input sample is associated with subsequent simulation.

additional_inspected_untagged_sources.summary: Preserves the original conditional branch for its non-online/loading path. In the online path it tracks per-frame pending/stable sound logs, stops sound instances present in the previous stable log but absent from the re-executed pending log, copies pending log to stable, and advances the sound/frame ring on a new frame. If stable rollback remains active and current frame is before the recorded end, it invokes the camera-task helper and branches to the engine-loop start; at/after the end it clears rollback-active flags and exits the input loop.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.gameplay_relevance: Directly re-runs engine frames during rollback and adjusts accompanying sound side effects; this is a simulation and user-visible audio timing boundary.

additional_inspected_untagged_sources.summary: Runs only for the online in-game scene when the field at 0x80479d64 is zero. When not in the rollback handler it can zero all four reports during the configured freeze window; clamps both local stick axes to zero when each coordinate is within ±2; replaces a local report whose status byte is -3 with the prior local input (the comment says the game likely does this but is unsure); saves the last input; sends frame index, stable finalized frame/checksum, delay and local report via EXI, then reads a response. RESP_SKIP can branch to the parent restore path without handling input unless game-over is set; RESP_DISCONNECTED and RESP_ADVANCE set flags. It rotates delayed local reports, stores rollback-local history, compares actual remote reports against predicted reports (buttons, raw stick bytes, and triggers with values <=42 treated as deadzone), advances matching predictions/finalized state, and sets rollback/savestate flags and end frame when a mismatch requires rollback. Missing remote inputs use the most recent received report and save prediction/input indices; the rollback handler replays local history and reuses opponent input loading. The hook increments ODB_FRAME on its normal exit.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.gameplay_relevance: Central online controller sampling, delayed/local and remote input routing, prediction, rollback trigger, and game-frame counter behavior.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.unresolved_dependency: The parent stack layout/PAD report semantics and status -3 meaning are not independently established; EXI packet/response semantics and target-side RX/TX generation are outside this ASM-only check; exact savestate timing/address bridge and controller transformations need runtime/reference checks; source comments identify uncertainty on freeze frame timing. Behavior here is online-client-specific and does not imply offline vanilla mode behavior.
additional_inspected_untagged_sources.status: additional bounded source review; not a complete recursive semantic audit; no runtime validation

additional_inspected_untagged_sources.summary: Calls the replaced StartMelee routine first, then limits added setup to the online in-game scene. Allocates ODB, TXB, RXB, SSRB and SSCB buffers. In this routine it explicitly calls Zero_AreaLength for ODB, RXB and SSCB; no corresponding zero call follows the TXB or SSRB allocations. It records the ODB/RX/control-buffer addresses and sizes for preservation across savestates; initializes game frame to 1 and the completion handler. Loads match-state data, writes local/input/remote indices and RNG offset into ODB, writes that offset into the global seed, and copies the match info block. It loads the MSRB_ALT_STAGE_MODE byte and stores that byte at offset +8 from the computed INJ_FREEZE_STADIUM branch target, as a parameter in gecko code space; this source does not establish a fixed frozen-stage policy. Ranked tiebreak path can overwrite timer to 180 and all four stock bytes to 1 (unless the last end-mode byte is 7); Ranked non-tiebreak sends match-start EXI data. Teams path derives and writes four costume indices. Delay is clamped to 1..15. Despite the “Clear A inputs” comment, the loop stores zero as a full 32-bit word at offset 0 of each 68-byte-stride pad entry based at 0x804c20bc, for all four ports; no A-only mask is applied in this hook. It creates an RNG GObj, and its procedure writes global seed from rotated global frame plus ODB RNG offset.
